cues.zh: 这是雷诺 R25。
cues.en: This is the Renault R25.

cues.zh: 作为为费尔南多·阿隆索赢得世界冠军的赛车……
cues.en: As the car that won Fernando Alonso a world championship...

cues.zh: 它是 F1 史上的传奇之一。
cues.en: it's one of the all-time F1 greats.

cues.zh: R25 也是强悍的 V10 时代最后一批赛车，
cues.en: The R25 is also the last of the breed from the monstrous V10 era,

cues.zh: 当时赛车能爆发出接近 1,000 马力。
cues.en: when the cars were chucking out close to 1,000 horsepower.

cues.zh: 今天不会搞《Top Gear》那些花活了。
cues.en: Now, there's going to be no Top Gear nonsense today.

cues.zh: 我不会让它跟猎豹或骑超级摩托的蝙蝠赛跑。
cues.en: I'm not going to race it against a cheetah or a bat on a superbike.

cues.zh: 我的任务只是把它开上赛道跑一圈。
cues.en: My mission is simply to get that round a track.

cues.zh: 具体来说，是在银石赛道的 Stowe 赛道跑两圈。
cues.en: Specifically, two laps around Stowe Circuit at Silverstone.

cues.zh: 更具体地说，是跑两圈
cues.en: More specifically, two laps

cues.zh: 还不能撞毁这台无价的世界冠军 F1 赛车。
cues.en: without stuffing a priceless World Championship-winning F1 car.

cues.zh: 先说说背景，
cues.en: Now, to put all this into context,

cues.zh: 我开过最快的公路车是布加迪威龙，
cues.en: the fastest road car I've ever driven is the Bugatti Veyron,

cues.zh: 它的功率重量比是每吨 530 马力。
cues.en: which has a power to weight ratio of 530 horsepower per ton.

cues.zh: 但它的功率重量比
cues.en: But the power to weight ratio of this

cues.zh: 是每吨1500马力。
cues.en: is 1,500 horsepower per tonne.

cues.zh: 但不仅仅是数字。
cues.en: But it's not just the numbers.

cues.zh: 没有什么能让你的头脑、你的感官、
cues.en: Nothing can prepare your mind, your senses,

cues.zh: 你的身体、你的反应时间为F1赛车的冲击做好准备。
cues.en: your body, your reaction times for the assault of a Formula 1 car.

cues.zh: 所以，在冲击之前，得先回学校进修。
cues.en: So, before the assault, it was back to school.

cues.zh: 我的老师将是赛车队老板Jonathan Lewis
cues.en: My teacher would be race team boss Jonathan Lewis

cues.zh: 我的第一课将在他的一辆小型雷诺方程式赛车中进行。
cues.en: and my first lesson would be in one of his little formula Renault cars.

cues.zh: -其实很简单。-在我看来就像一辆F1赛车，
cues.en: -It's very simple, really. -It looks like a Formula 1 car to me,

cues.zh: 只是小了一点，也没那么繁琐。
cues.en: only a bit smaller and not quite as fiddly.

cues.zh: 好吧。嗯，它确实是辆小型方程式赛车。
cues.en: Okay. Well, it is a baby formula car.

cues.zh: 作为布加迪威龙的资深驾驶者，我急于向他展示我的实力！
cues.en: As a Veyron veteran, I was keen to show him what I could do!

cues.zh: 不过，雷诺方程式只有一台来自Clio的区区两升发动机，
cues.en: Still, the Formula Renault only has a piddly two-litre engine from a Clio,

cues.zh: 所以掌握它应该很容易。
cues.en: so mastering it should be easy.

cues.zh: 好，我要试着在直道上加点油。
cues.en: Right, I'm about going to try and gas it a bit down the straight.

cues.zh: 我以前从没让完全的新手开过我们的车。
cues.en: I've never let a complete novice go out in one of our cars before.

cues.zh: 雷诺方程式的动力只有F1赛车的五分之一
cues.en: The Formula Renault has only one fifth the power of an F1 car

cues.zh: 我现在才意识到自己要爬的山有多高。
cues.en: and I now realised the size of the mountain I had to climb.

cues.zh: 我终于体验到了真正的刹车是什么感觉！简直像撞墙一样！
cues.en: I've experienced what proper brakes are! It's like hitting a wall!

cues.zh: 就在我刚开始适应这辆车的时候，
cues.en: And just as I was getting used to this car,

cues.zh: 我被塞进了它的大哥，
cues.en: I was shoved into its bigger brother,

cues.zh: 一辆世界系列赛赛车，动力是雷诺方程式的两倍。
cues.en: a World Series car, with twice the power of the Formula Renault.

cues.zh: 他不说话了。
cues.en: He's gone quiet.

cues.zh: 难怪！直线速度我还能应付，
cues.en: And no wonder! The straight-line speed I could cope with,

cues.zh: 但到了弯道，我脑子根本转不了那么快。
cues.en: but in the corners, I just couldn't think fast enough to react.=

cues.zh: 我很快！但我不知道该多信任它！
cues.en: I'm quick! I don't know how much to trust it!

cues.zh: 就是太……要学的东西太多了。
cues.en: It's just so.... There's so much to learn.

cues.zh: 我开得不够快，刹车热不起来，然后就完全没有刹车了。
cues.en: I can't drive fast enough to get the heat in the brakes and then there's no brakes.

cues.zh: 我刚驾驭完500制动马力
cues.en: I've just grappled with 500 brake horsepower

cues.zh: 在一辆500公斤的车里，而我才走了一半。
cues.en: in a 500 kilo car and I'm only halfway there.

cues.zh: 我被叫去看车载遥测的数据读数。
cues.en: I was summoned to look at the readouts from my on-board telemetry.

cues.zh: 你一边踩着刹车，一边踩着油门。
cues.en: You're riding the brake and you're riding the accelerator.

cues.zh: 那是因为我在用左脚刹车。
cues.en: It's 'cause I'm doing left-foot braking.

cues.zh: 还有一点，你在一次降挡时动作太猛了
cues.en: And the other thing is, you've been quite severe on one of the downshifts

cues.zh: 把转速拉到了八千五。
cues.en: and you've put eight-and-a-half on the motor.

cues.zh: 如果我按那圈的开法
cues.en: If I'd done what I did on that lap

cues.zh: 开一辆F1赛车，会怎么样？
cues.en: in a Formula 1 car, what would have happened?

cues.zh: 你多半会打转，还会把引擎搞报废。
cues.en: You'd have probably spun it and wrecked the engine.

cues.zh: F1赛车重建一台引擎要多少钱？
cues.en: How much is an engine rebuild on a Formula 1 car?

cues.zh: 大概15万、20万，甚至更多。
cues.en: Probably about 150,000, 200,000 or more.

cues.zh: 我需要在World Series赛车里多练很多时间，
cues.en: I needed lots more time in the World Series car,

cues.zh: 但这不可能实现……
cues.en: but that wasn't going to happen...

cues.zh: 因为我的肌肉难以承受过弯的离心力。
cues.en: because my muscles were struggling to cope with the cornering forces.

cues.zh: 我的脑袋都快飞出去了，我没开玩笑。
cues.en: My head is going to come off and I'm not joking.

cues.zh: 他的脖子很快也受不了，所以他得去开F1。
cues.en: His neck will go soon, so, he needs to drive the Formula 1.

cues.zh: 在继续之前，Yoda给我打了打气。
cues.en: Before I moved on, Yoda gave me a pep talk.

cues.zh: 你在世界系列赛赛车中体验到的一切
cues.en: Everything you experience in the World Series car

cues.zh: 大概会是三倍以上，
cues.en: is probably going to be more than three times as much,

cues.zh: 甚至更多，在F1里。
cues.en: maybe more, in the Formula 1.

cues.zh: 我的思考时间，那是我的问题，我有点失误了。
cues.en: My thinking time, that was my problem and I had a bit of an off.

cues.zh: 是因为我觉得刹车太晚了。
cues.en: It's because I thought I'd left it too late to brake.

cues.zh: 然后我意识到其实没有，但正因为我在这么想，
cues.en: Then I realised I hadn't, but because I was thinking that,

cues.zh: 车已经过弯了，我挂错了挡，然后打转了。
cues.en: the car was already round the corner and I was in the wrong gear and I span.

cues.zh: 我思考得不够快，这比什么都关键。
cues.en: I can't think fast enough, more than anything else.

cues.zh: 你得集中注意力，尤其是开那玩意儿。
cues.en: You're going to have to concentrate, especially with that thing.

cues.zh: 如果你觉得那已经很难了，那还要再上一个层次。
cues.en: If you think that's hard, that's going to be another level.

cues.zh: 真舒服。
cues.en: That's snug.

cues.zh: 如果你才十岁，我这是在替你干。你跟我一起在这儿呢。
cues.en: If you are ten, I'm doing this on your behalf. You're in here with me.

cues.zh: 现在我控制住油门了。
cues.en: Now I've got control of the throttle.

cues.zh: 那是我。
cues.en: That's me.

cues.zh: 天哪，那是我在轰F1引擎。
cues.en: Dear God, that's me revving a Formula 1 engine.

cues.zh: 整个F1车队的人都在盯着我。
cues.en: The eyes of the whole F1 team were upon me.

cues.zh: 关键时刻到了。
cues.en: This was it.

cues.zh: 轰油门。
cues.en: Rev.

cues.zh: 我花了一分钟才挪了40英尺。
cues.en: It had taken me a minute to do 40 feet.

cues.zh: 我们要一路倒回去吗？全都关了吗？
cues.en: Are we going all the way back in? Is it all off?

cues.zh: 熄火的问题就在这儿。
cues.en: Here's the problem with the stalling.

cues.zh: 我知道这很好笑，但这车有套系统。要是熄火了，那就是灾难。
cues.en: I know it's very funny, but the car has a system. If you stall, it's a disaster.

cues.zh: 所以，你起步的时候，如果它觉得你动力不够，
cues.en: So, as you're setting off, if it thinks you haven't got enough power,

cues.zh: 它就会重新切进离合器，你就只能像个傻瓜一样。
cues.en: it just cuts the clutch in again and you just look an idiot.

cues.zh: -八次。-八次防熄火？
cues.en: -Eight. -Eight anti-stalls?

cues.zh: 这算纪录了吧？
cues.en: That's a record, isn't it?

cues.zh: 等车队笑话完我，又把轮胎暖了暖
cues.en: After the team had laughed at me and warmed the tyres

cues.zh: 让它们更抓地之后，他们就放我上路了。
cues.en: to make them more grippy, they sent me on my way.

cues.zh: 天哪！
cues.en: Oh, God!

cues.zh: 感觉跟另一辆车完全不一样。完全不同。
cues.en: It feels totally different to the other car. Totally different.

cues.zh: 左转……天哪，我开上F1赛车了！
cues.en: Turning left... my God, I'm in a Formula 1 car!

cues.zh: 我试试踩油门，看看会怎样……
cues.en: I'm going to try the throttle and see what...

cues.zh: 天哪！天哪！
cues.en: Oh, my God! Oh, my God!

cues.zh: 我的老天！
cues.en: Holy mother!

cues.zh: 刹车完全没有温度。
cues.en: There's no temperature in the brakes.

cues.zh: 在我勉强跑完的半圈里，这辆车给我留下了深刻印象。
cues.en: In the half a lap I'd managed, the car had made a big impression.

cues.zh: 它绝对是世界上最了不起的机器。
cues.en: It's absolutely the most glorious machine... in the world.

cues.zh: 我已经开到我感觉的极限速度了。
cues.en: I'm going as fast as I feel I can.

cues.zh: 但这速度不足以让轮胎升温，也就是说我没有抓地力，也没有下压力。
cues.en: It's not fast enough to heat the tyres, which means I've no grip or down force.

cues.zh: 如果我开得再快一点，
cues.en: If I go a bit faster than that,

cues.zh: 轮胎依然不会升温，也没有下压力，然后我就会撞车。
cues.en: there'll still be no heat in the tyres and no down force and I will crash.

cues.zh: 从我现在的位置，唯一的出路就是开得快得多。
cues.en: The only way from where I am now is a lot faster.

cues.zh: 那样轮胎才会有温度、有抓地力，我才不会撞车。
cues.en: Then I'll have heat in the tyres and grip and I won't crash.

cues.zh: 更糟的是，帮我盯遥测数据的那位可不是什么开心果。
cues.en: And to make things worse, the man with my telemetry was hardly a bag of laughs.

cues.zh: 从你松油门到踩刹车之间，间隔太大了。
cues.en: There's a big gap between where you're lifting off and braking.

cues.zh: 你应该松油门后立刻踩刹车。
cues.en: You should come straight off the accelerator onto the brakes.

cues.zh: -对。-没必要留那么大间隔。
cues.en: -Right. -There's no need for that big gap.

cues.zh: 间隔有多大？
cues.en: How big a gap is it?

cues.zh: 松油门后隔了半秒……
cues.en: Half a second between you lifting off...

cues.zh: -不算大吧？-应该立刻踩。
cues.en: -Not massive, is it? -It should be straightaway.

cues.zh: 不过他说得对。
cues.en: He was right, though.

cues.zh: 如果我要用这车跑两圈，就得拼尽全力。
cues.en: If I was going to do two laps in this thing, I had to dig deep.

cues.zh: 我得把学到的一切都想清楚。
cues.en: I've got to think about everything I've learned.

cues.zh: 天哪！天哪！天哪！
cues.en: Oh, God! Oh, God! Oh, God!

cues.zh: 太不可思议了。
cues.en: That's unbelievable.

cues.zh: 刹车没有温度。
cues.en: There's no temperature in the brakes.

cues.zh: 感觉它们不起作用。
cues.en: They feel like they're not working.

cues.zh: 我跑完了一圈！再来一圈。
cues.en: I'd done a lap! Just one more.

cues.zh: 入弯。
cues.en: Turning in.

cues.zh: 哦，太美了。
cues.en: Oh, it's beautiful.

cues.zh: 我猜首席机械师见过更好的表现。
cues.en: I suspect the chief mechanic had seen better.

cues.zh: 但在我看来，他就是驾驶之神。
cues.en: But as far as I was concerned, driving god.

cues.zh: 这是全世界最吓人的事。
cues.en: It's the most scary thing in the whole world.

cues.zh: 最后一个弯道要来了。我在刹车。挂二挡。
cues.en: The last corner is coming up. I'm braking. I'm in second.

cues.zh: 我要对准那条线。
cues.en: I'm going to aim it for the line.

cues.zh: 我做到了！我做到了！我做到了！
cues.en: I've done it! I've done it! I've done it!

cues.zh: 我的天哪！
cues.en: Holy crap!

cues.zh: 为纪念这一刻，技师们让引擎表演了它的拿手好戏。
cues.en: To mark the occasion, the technicians let the engine play its party piece.
